The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8081` (see `RedpandaBuilder.SchemaRegistryPort`)
- Port: `9092` (see `RedpandaBuilder.RedpandaPort`)
- Startup script: Generates a script when the container starts and runs it as the main process.
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Started Kafka API server` is logged.
